landing.status_pill: AI as a Financial Participant • Production Ready
landing.hero_subtitle: Eliminate cash-flow blindspots. Convert raw invoices into auditable ledgers, forecast working-capital runways with 95% confidence intervals, and pre-qualify for institutional SME bank loans in real time.
landing.arch_desc: Unlike consumer expense apps, SME Finance Copilot acts as an autonomous financial participant enforcing GAAP/IFRS principles.
landing.feat1_desc: Combines chronological rolling-origin ARIMA with LightGBM regressors to project 7, 14, 30, and 90-day liquidity intervals with 95% confidence intervals.
landing.feat2_desc: Extracts supplier invoices and cash receipts in English, Chinese (Fapiao), and Bengali (Mushak). Requires human review before posting to prevent financial distortion.
landing.feat3_desc: Client identity headers are rejected. Every shop transaction is cryptographically scoped via signed HMAC session tokens with immutable audit trail logging.
landing.feat4_desc: Calculates Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), reducing vs flat-rate EMI schedules, and matches loan applications with statutory covenants in Bangladesh and China.
landing.feat5_desc: Conversational AI agent that diagnoses expense anomalies, checks tax thresholds, simulates hiring or inventory expansion, and drafts bank financing packets.
landing.feat6_desc: English first, Simplified Chinese second, Bengali preserved. Supports RTL layout detection, currency decimal multipliers, and statutory tax rules.
landing.sim_desc: Adjust monthly revenue and desired loan size to observe real-time bank suitability.
landing.sim_prime_verdict: ✓ Prime Bank Quality — High Approval Probability
landing.sim_tight_verdict: ⚠ Moderate Risk — Collateral or Working Capital Boost Recommended
landing.models_desc: Statistical and machine learning algorithms benchmarked against chronological test splits and historical SME actuals.
landing.security_desc: Every financial transaction is scoped at the database level with HMAC token authentication and immutable logging.
landing.sec1_desc: Client identity headers like X-User-ID are strictly ignored. Only cryptographically verified tokens establish tenant access.
landing.sec2_desc: All ledger balances and interest repayments are calculated in integer minor units with zero float contamination.
landing.sec3_desc: Database triggers record before-and-after cryptographic checksums for all schema writes to prevent audit repudiation.
landing.footer_built_for: Built for High-Growth SME Retailers Across Bangladesh, China & Global Markets.
landing.footer_rights: All rights reserved. Zero numerical hallucinations guaranteed.
landing.sim_risk_verdict: ✕ High Debt Risk — EMI Exceeds Operating Cash Buffer
landing.model1_desc: Captures 7, 14, 30, and 90-day cash trends with 95% confidence intervals and 58% beat over random-walk.
landing.model2_desc: Working capital regression model that learns non-linear retail sales surges and supplier payment patterns.
landing.model3_desc: TF-IDF + Logistic Regression categorizing English invoices, Chinese Fapiao (发票), and Bengali Mushak 6.3.
landing.model4_desc: Mathematical guardrail calculating exact reducing-balance EMI and debt-to-income without LLM float errors.
landing.preloader_desc: Custom animated telemetry assets rendered in pure responsive scalable vectors.
landing.feat_crm_desc: Automated WhatsApp and SMS payment chase for overdue dues with RFM loyalty segmentation.
landing.feat_inv_desc: FIFO & WAC inventory valuation, stock turnover tracking, and automated reorder purchase orders.
landing.feat_voice_desc: Voice-driven financial queries in English, Bengali, and Chinese for real-time P&L insights.
landing.feat_forecast_desc: Rolling ARIMA and LightGBM models projecting 7, 14, 30, and 90-day cash liquidity.
landing.evidence_desc: Topic E-এর জন্য সিমুলেটেড অ্যাকাউন্ট বা স্যান্ডবক্স পরিবেশের অপারেশনাল লগ (API Request/Response Payload) এবং এআই এজেন্টের টুল কলিং এক্সিকিউশনের প্রমাণ।

how_it_works.page_title: How It Works — SME Finance Copilot Operator Guide
how_it_works.hero_badge: SME Operator Guide • Autonomous Financial Workflow
how_it_works.hero_desc: From scanning multilingual paper invoices to generating GAAP-compliant general ledgers, 95% confidence cash runways, automated debt recovery, and 1-click institutional bank credit packets.
how_it_works.arch_title: An AI Participant, Not Just Another Record App
how_it_works.arch_desc: Unlike static accounting software where data must be manually keyed in, SME Finance Copilot actively participates in your business: watching cash thresholds, chasing overdue customers, forecasting liquidity, and assembling bank credit dossiers.
how_it_works.phase1_desc: Scan paper receipts, thermal chalan, cash memos, or PDF supplier invoices in Bengali, English, or Chinese.
how_it_works.phase2_desc: High-confidence extracts post automatically. Low-confidence invoices trigger review cards for one-click approval.
how_it_works.phase3_desc: All financial values are stored as immutable 64-bit integer minor units. Zero floating-point rounding errors.
how_it_works.phase4_desc: Machine learning models project daily liquidity with 95% confidence intervals and pinpoint cash shortage days.
how_it_works.phase5_desc: Categorizes customers with RFM analysis and drafts courteous WhatsApp or SMS payment reminders automatically.
how_it_works.phase6_desc: Computes verified DSCR metrics and exports tamper-evident PDF dossiers formatted for bank credit evaluation.
